exact_statement: On any finite Boolean restriction/admission DAG with slack S=KI-H, prescribed local stopping-hull credit increments delta_b=rho_M(child_b)-E rho_M(children), and unchanged credit on admissions, the exact capital supporting every subsequent query/admission/stopping choice is T(v,M)=max{(-S(v))_+,T(v,M+j),T(child_b,M)-delta_b}. It equals the maximum over actual paths of terminal deficit minus cumulative delta. For all Boolean functions on at most3 bits and all K>=0, T(v,empty)=rho_all(v). At K=1 the explicit Boolean family F_d(s,x)=chi_3(x) with its sign flipped only at the all-zero vertex, d>=0 selector bits and3 parity bits, has full stopping hull R_d=max_(0<=r<=3,0<=t<=d) 2^(-(d+3-r-t))*(H_(r+t)-I_(r,t))_+, where I_(r,t)=r+2*(r+t-2*r)/2^(r+t) for r+t>=1, H_m is the entropy of one mass (1-2/2^m)^2 and2^m-1 masses4/2^(2*m), and H_0=I_(0,0)=0. It obeys 0<R_d<=8*(d+4)/2^(d+3), while sequential local-hull admission capital T_d>=1/2; hence sup_d T_d/R_d=infinity. For d=1 exactly R_1=1/4 and T_1=1/2. Credit-owner and signed-debit labels can be preserved conditionally whenever this capital criterion holds. This is an admission-accounting obstruction at rate1, not a rate4 or FEI counterexample.

exact_statement: For finite outcome weights w>=0 summing to1, existing nonnegative credits c and required nonnegative envelope bounds u admit mean-conserving credit rerouting c+f>=u iff E c>=E u. The sharp minimum E(f)_+ is E(u-c)_+, attained by f=(u-c)_+-(E(u-c)_+/E(c-u)_+)(c-u)_+ with the zero-denominator boundary handled separately. On any finite Boolean restriction/admission DAG, a full-universe superharmonic majorant u>=(-S_K)_+ and initial credit a>=u(root) therefore support every adaptive admission/query/stop after minimum necessary rebalancing of each local-hull baseline, with separately conserved nonnegative credit owners, conserved signed debit labels, nonnegative total debits and no new outside credit. Taking u=R_all gives the sharp initial bank. In particular the same original R_d pays every policy on every A072 marked-point Boolean F_d at K=1 under this repaired allocator, although no constant multiple of R_d suffices uniformly for the original unmodified local-hull allocator.
